time_support.common_tau: minimum final central proper time among all three spatial runs; no shifts or rescaling
time_support.temporal_tau: minimum final central proper time among coarse, medium and half-CFL medium
time_support.peak_extraction: max of original integration samples before common cutoff and linearly interpolated value at cutoff, not merely max of downsampled trace
time_support.decomposition: signed native peak difference = signed common-cutoff peak difference + signed difference of excluded-tail peak increments; separate per Ricci proxy. Temporal and spatial separately. Common cutoff is not proof of matching physical event.
time_support.report: native and common peak values, signed/absolute relative difference, cutoff tail increments, time of maxima, stop time in t and tau, threshold overshoot
time_support.authority: Common central proper time is authoritative for spatial comparison; native threshold-stop peak remains mandatory as separate event diagnostic. Both must satisfy medium-fine 2% Ricci gate. Coordinate-time trace comparison diagnostic only, no fit or extrapolation.
time_support.native_order: Retain R4B5A native peak order criterion and common order criteria unchanged; discrete stop overshoot may cause failure. No claim of convergence beyond common support.

recovery_policy: Keep historical R4B5 coarse-medium native Ricci FAIL unchanged. Recovery needs medium-fine native AND common-time peak Ricci <=2%, both proxies, all other pair criteria, temporal gate, all nine common-support observed orders within frozen 1.5–2.5, and decreasing native peak differences reported separately. Original lower endpoint already passed. Result only revised resolution-specific upper endpoint, not retroactive coarse pair pass. Native orders reported separately; if inconsistent, label native-order hold, do not silently promote.

boundary.per_run: actual face flux and separately integrated interior flux r=12, normalized residual <1%, distinguish near-zero outer flux from outgoing validation

independent_family.normalization: central proper time integral alpha(0)dt, same origin, 32769 uniform samples on common support, no fit or shift; incoming window begins at tau(small t=12); both fluxes at same tau cutoff
independent_family.far_invariance: R50 vs R62.5 verified in sealed R4B5A.1 archive; replay small and R50 at same h, candidate BC both, check measured peak C, Ricci and residual against archive <=1e-8 relative; raw drift diagnostic only; actual outer and independent interior residual <1%

boundary.near_trapping_scope: finite pre-stop balance only, no assertion of outgoing strong-field validation

budget.before_fine: elapsed + projected <=3000; replay, temporal and independent boundary all pass

forbidden: DSS including synthetic/null tests in this branch
historical_scope: R4B5A.1 recovery valid only novel A=.14; A=.1152 fresh finite pre-stop balance at outer R30 and inner r12 on every grid. No DSS/AMR, no bracket narrowing.
